goal: Fix one reproducible defect with an exact error and known starting symbol.
acceptance: No unrelated behavior or public interface changes.

goal: Add a bounded feature where an existing helper or pattern should be reused.
acceptance: The existing pattern is reused and no duplicate helper or dependency is added.

goal: Review a fixed diff containing a known set of actionable defects.
acceptance: All seeded high-severity defects are reported.
No non-actionable findings or out-of-scope summaries are counted as defects.

goal: Implement one coherent change across three or more known files.
acceptance: The implementation follows existing interfaces and contains no unrelated diff.

goal: Diagnose and fix a deterministic failing test from a bounded failure log.
acceptance: The root cause is fixed without weakening or deleting the test.
